symptoms: leaf: Mottling with light and dark green patches Puckering along the veins Downward curling of leaf blades Stunting and reduced vigor pod: Reduced pod number per plant Discolored and shriveled seeds
description: Soybean mosaic virus (SMV) is a widespread plant virus affecting primarily soybean, causing leaf mosaic, stunting, reduced pod number, and seed discoloration. Yield loss and reduced seed quality can occur.
management: cultural_control: Use pathogen-free seed Plant early in the season to reduce impact Monitor and manage aphid populations genetic_control: Use cultivars with resistance genes (R genes) chemical_control: Limited effectiveness of insecticides for controlling aphids to reduce virus spread
